_comment: The admitted measure sources. A PR that adds or bumps an entry is how a measure enters Penlight; the tag + sha256 pins are what the pipeline downloads. Entries with pending_release are read from local checkouts until their first tagged release.

measures.name: sunscore
measures.notes: Street-level sun access from the 2022 Cook County LiDAR DSM; 18 m grid. Ward values still come from the repo's own ward summary, so only neighborhoods and χGRIDs are aggregated here. Nominated by Jackie Schmitz, 43rd Ward.

measures.name: zonewise
measures.notes: Passed Chicago rezonings (City Clerk eLMS, 2011+) as dated points, plus the current City zoning map (dj47-wfun, 2026-10-19) as 10 m rasters: 4 yearly rezoning metrics via time_field/sum and 6 zoning-composition metrics dated by layer as_of. Districts read from ordinances and the Council Journal, checked against the City zoning map. byop/v1.1 source: needs a consumer that supports v1.1.

measures.name: screenreach
measures.notes: Movie-theater reach, the worked point-of-interest example: 66 operating cinemas in Chicago and a 15-mile ring (Google Maps sweep 2026-10-22; status and screen counts checked by a model with web search, verified by a stronger model, disagreements settled by hand) plus 2020 Census block populations. Five population-weighted reach metrics via ratio (nearest, 5th-nearest and nearest independent cinema; screens within 3 mi; screens per 100k by two-step floating catchment) and in-area cinema and screen counts (sum: byop/v1.1 source).

measures.name: panopticounts
measures.notes: License-plate readers, aggregates only: every vendor's ALPRs mapped in OpenStreetMap (2026-10-27) merged with Flock Safety's in-service plate readers from the Dec 2025 inventory behind Proton's Flock camera map (not redistributed). Wards and community areas computed directly, tracts for the χGRID (byop v1.3 layer geography). Five metrics, all weight 0 and all direction_contested (byop v1.4): privacy or safety is the reader's call. Confidence medium: OSM had mapped only 65% of Flock's in-service readers (57% south of Madison), so non-Flock readers are undercounted.

measures.name: parkability
measures.notes: Ward values still come from the repo's own ward summary; two fixed-geography metrics stay ward-only.

measures.name: rentrate
measures.notes: Cook County parcels; the absentee layer is the full 1.6 M parcels (216 MB) — a release should publish the documented parcel-digit sample instead.

measures.name: microhappiness
measures.notes: Synthetic small-area estimates (GSS × ACS/PLACES MRP), nationwide tracts + ZCTAs; labeled modeled, never observed.
